articles.title: The AI Competence/Judgement Gap
articles.summary: AI is expanding our ability to produce work faster than our ability to judge it, creating a growing competence gap around quality, expertise, and accountability.

articles.title: Nobody's Actually Prioritising ‘Value'
articles.summary: Product teams cannot meaningfully prioritize on “value” without first defining what matters through strategy and outcomes. Since expected value is ultimately a hypothesis, better prioritization comes from comparing bets based on evidence and confidence in their ability to move the desired outcome.

articles.title: Roadmap decisions rather than dates
articles.summary: As AI reduces implementation bottlenecks, decision speed becomes the real constraint. Teams should roadmap around unresolved decisions, not dates.

articles.title: Landing the plane
articles.summary: The last 10% of a project is often the hardest. Strong leaders protect scope, increase focus, and deliberately guide teams across the finish line.

articles.title: Keep Calm and Carry On… With Your Demo
articles.summary: Successful software demos rely on a clear narrative and flexible recovery strategies rather than avoiding surprises. By organizing sprints around user journeys, maintaining lightweight run-of-show notes, preparing recorded demos, troubleshooting safely, and assigning a support partner, presenters can handle unexpected bugs, data issues, or timing gaps smoothly.

articles.title: Spec-driven development: When the spec becomes the product
articles.summary: As AI lowers code generation costs, software development's bottleneck shifts from implementation to intent, coordination, and review. Treat a living, versioned product specification as the source of truth, defining each feature as a delta that systems propagate across product surfaces before generating and verifying code.

articles.title: Cutting the Noise
articles.summary: Product teams should simplify before they add. Removing stale processes, meetings, tools, and backlog items creates more space for meaningful work and better decisions.

articles.title: This Essay is 10% AI Generated
articles.summary: As AI writing becomes increasingly convincing, the debate is shifting from writing quality to authorship. People still want to know who shaped and stands behind an idea because authorship provides context, meaning, and a way to evaluate what we read.

articles.title: The top reasons AI stalls inside companies
articles.summary: AI adoption is rarely blocked by tools or intelligence.

articles.title: Generative Media Beyond the Model Race
articles.summary: The competitive focus of generative media is shifting from individual models to orchestrating specialized systems through agent frameworks and human taste.
